title: Regional Design Studio
description:
Prerequisite: LARC411 and LARC231.
Corequisite: LARC412.
Restriction: Junior standing or higher; and must be in Landscape Architecture program.
Credit only granted for: LARC330 or LARC440.
Formerly: LARC440. The landscape architect's role within the interdisciplinary urban design process, focusing on urban site design issues. Pedestrian friendly site design and the future of sustainable development will be studied.
